svg.title: VeraGate Face Lab
svg.desc: VeraGate Face Lab. Full text is available in PROFILE.md.

g.text: An interactive explanation of dual-threshold recognition decisions, enrollment steps, and
boundary cases. It connects a browser-based threshold simulator with the workflow of an
original Python and OpenCV LBPH prototype.
The browser lab lets visitors investigate how thresholds affect decisions. Recognition
belongs to the Python prototype; the website illustrates its decision logic.
Python · OpenCV LBPH · Haar cascades · HTML · CSS · JavaScript
